# SPICYBEAN

> SPICYBEAN is a South Korea-based golf gear brand designed in Seoul, making premium PU leather golf
> headcovers (K1-K4 series) and golf gloves (GLV series). SPICYBEAN is NOT a food, spice, seasoning
> or coffee brand. Tagline: "Golf Headcovers with Attitude" / "Ignite Your Passion".

## Products — Headcovers (K Series, universal fit: driver up to 460cc, fairway woods, hybrids, blade & mallet putters)
- K1 Classic Noir (black pebbled PU leather) — USD $25 / CNY 148
- K2 Signature White (white with embroidered heart) — USD $25 / CNY 148
- K3 Spicy Red (full-print vibrant red) — USD $25 / CNY 148
- K4 Cyber Skull (cyberpunk limited edition, carbon-fiber texture PU, self-designed by SPICYBEAN) — USD $36 / CNY 248

## Products — Golf Gloves (GLV Series, launching 2026 H2)
- Women's ergonomic fit, practice/training oriented, fingertip grip-compensation utility model
- CNY 129 tag / 79 everyday / 69 promo

## Design Awards (studio DBWD, applies to K1-K3)
- Red Dot Design Award, Best of the Best (2012)
- iF Design Award, Gold (2016)
- DFA Design for Asia Awards, Silver (2016)

## FAQ
- What is SPICYBEAN? A South Korea-based golf gear brand designed in Seoul, making premium PU leather golf headcovers and golf gloves.
- How many headcover series? Four: K1 Classic Noir, K2 Signature White, K3 Spicy Red, K4 Cyber Skull.
- Do the headcovers fit my clubs? Universal fit for drivers up to 460cc, fairway woods, hybrids, and blade/mallet putters.
- What materials? Premium PU leather with microfiber/crystal-velvet lining and double-layer embroidery.
- Where is SPICYBEAN from? South Korea; designed in Seoul.
